title: Factbox-Tesla's China operations, the EV maker's global production powerhouse
title_zh: Factbox-特斯拉的中国业务，这家电动汽车制造商的全球生产基地
summary: Tesla is considering a separation of its China business to pave the way for a potential merger with SpaceX, the Wall Street Journal reported, ‌citing a person familiar with the talks. Reuters was unable to independently verify the report.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》援引一位知情人士的话报道，特斯拉正在考虑剥离其中国业务，为与 SpaceX 的潜在合并铺平道路。路透社无法独立核实该报道。

title: Asia stocks surge, yen falls after BOJ holds rates
title_zh: 日本央行维持利率不变后，亚洲股市飙升，日元下跌
summary: By Rae Wee SINGAPORE, July 31 (Reuters) - Asian markets rallied hard with Wall Street on Friday as South Korea's battered market made a record comeback, stirring hopes that the recent selloff in AI-
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 7 月 31 日 - 周五，亚洲市场与华尔街一起强劲反弹，韩国遭受重创的市场创纪录地卷土重来，引发了人们对近期人工智能抛售的希望。

title: Sony hikes profit forecast on gaming strength
title_zh: 索尼上调游戏实力盈利预期
summary: Sony on Friday hiked its full-year operating profit forecast by 8% to 1.72 trillion yen ($10.72 billion), ‌citing the strength of its gaming business.
summary_zh: 索尼周五将全年营业利润预期上调 8%，至 1.72 万亿日元（107.2 亿美元），理由是其游戏业务的强劲表现。

title: Indian shares seen opening higher on global cues, foreign buying
title_zh: 印度股市因全球线索和外国买盘而开盘走高
summary: July 31 (Reuters) - Indian shares were expected to open higher on Friday, supported by a rebound in Asian markets and renewed foreign buying that improved sentiment towards domestic equities.
summary_zh: 路透 7 月 31 日 - 受亚洲市场反弹以及外国买盘重燃改善国内股市情绪的支撑，印度股市周五开盘走高。

title: Tesla weighs sale of China business to pave way for potential SpaceX merger, WSJ reports
title_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，特斯拉考虑出售中国业务，为潜在的 SpaceX 合并铺平道路
summary: July 30 (Reuters) - Tesla executives have been told to prepare for a separation of its China business ahead of a potential merger with SpaceX, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday, citing a
summary_zh: 7 月 30 日（路透社）——《华尔街日报》周四援引一位知情人士的话报道称，特斯拉高管已被告知，在与 SpaceX 可能合并之前，准备剥离其中国业务。

title: Tim Cook's final earnings call as Apple CEO
title_zh: 蒂姆·库克作为苹果首席执行官的最后一次财报电话会议
summary: Tim Cook delivered his final earnings call as Apple's (AAPL) CEO before passing the baton to incoming CEO John Ternus.
summary_zh: 蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 发表了作为苹果公司 (AAPL) 首席执行官的最后一次财报电话会议，然后将接力棒交给了即将上任的首席执行官约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus)。

title: Wall Street ends sharply higher, lifted by soaring Microsoft
title_zh: 受微软飙升提振，华尔街股市大幅收高

title: Amazon earnings: AWS's growth rate 'no doubt' justifies the big AI spending
title_zh: 亚马逊财报：AWS 的增长率“毫无疑问”证明了人工智能方面的巨额支出是合理的
summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter earnings results that beat Wall Street's expectations. CFRA Research senior vice president of equity research, Arun Sundaram, chats with Yahoo Finance about his expectations for AWS.
summary_zh: 亚马逊（AMZN）公布的第二季度盈利结果超出了华尔街的预期。 CFRA Research 股票研究高级副总裁 Arun Sundaram 与雅虎财经谈论了他对 AWS 的期望。

title: Amazon Q2 earnings results beat Wall Street's estimates, as AWS continues to boom
title_zh: AWS 继续蓬勃发展，亚马逊第二季度盈利超出华尔街预期
summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter results on Thursday after the closing bell, with revenue coming in at $200.60 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $197.01 billion). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.
summary_zh: 周四收盘后，亚马逊 (AMZN) 公布了第二季度业绩，营收为 2006 亿美元（分析师预期为 1970.1 亿美元）。雅虎财经高级商业记者伊内斯·费雷 (Ines Ferré) 仔细研究了这些重大数据。
